description.value: Harvest Market is UBC Food Services' flagship campus grocery store, situated at Ponderosa Commons on the University of British Columbia's Vancouver campus. It stocks basic groceries alongside gourmet prepared foods including rotisserie chicken, fresh salads, epic sandwiches, and take-out meals, making it a well-rounded provisioning stop. The market sits at a busy campus crossroads and serves tens of thousands of students, staff, and faculty daily.

address.value: Ponderosa Commons, Corner of University Blvd & West Mall, Vancouver, BC
